results.content:
Jun 28, 2026

Image 39: Rated 2 out of 5 stars

## Pixels has a nice selection of artist…
Pixels has a nice selection of artist work and the print quality is generally good. However, as a long-time Premium member, I’ve experienced persistent technical issues with my account, including artworks not displaying correctly after edits, frozen recent visit stats, and inconsistent thumbnail/banner updates.  
Tech Support responses are slow or not-at-all. The problems continue despite multiple tickets. Other artists’ accounts seem to update normally.  
The platform has potential, but these ongoing visibility and display glitches make it frustrating for serious artists trying to present and sell their work.  
I hope the team can address these backend issues soon.
